tracks.name: Token-World v1 · RoboTwin 50-task frozen VLM feature fidelity
tracks.tasks: 50 tasks, 100 trajectories/task, 50 success and 50 failure per task
tracks.protocol: Predicted compact-state-decoded VLM feature versus ground-truth frozen Qwen3-VL feature under fixed action replay. Different from task success rate; same 50 tasks and 9:1 split across simulators.
tracks.trainingRegime: 5000 RoboTwin trajectories: 50 success + 50 failure per task, 9:1 train-val; RGB-generating comparators are re-encoded with identical frozen VLM.

tracks.name: Token-World v1 · RoboTwin frozen policy action consistency
tracks.version: RoboTwin 50-task source v1 Table I, fixed downstream policy
tracks.metric: Fixed policy output action cosine similarity
tracks.protocol: Frozen policy actions inferred from predicted VLM-feature representation compared with same frozen policy from ground-truth VLM features. This is a continuous similarity, not task success rate.
tracks.trainingRegime: Same RoboTwin 5000 trajectories and reference-policy evaluation; no re-training of frozen downstream policy in the metric.
